reviews.author: Prisy F…
reviews.body: I’ve trusted Leidy with my nails for over 2 years, and I wouldn’t go anywhere else! She is so kind, professional, and incredibly talented. Every design she creates is a work of art, especially her amazing freehand work. She always pays attention to every little detail, and my nails come out perfect every single time. On top of that, her prices are very fair for the quality she delivers. If you’re looking for a nail artist who is creative, reliable, and truly passionate about her work, Leidy is the one. I can’t recommend her enough! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
